keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «섬의 큰 산이 화산이었다(위험)» 와 «아리와 아빠가 아슬아슬하게 빠져나왔다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the danger (the mountain is a volcano) and the ending (Ari and Dad escape just in time). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The big mountain on the island is a volcano, and smoke comes out.
They run to the boat and escape just in time.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why do Ari and Dad run down the hill?
qs.qko: 아리와 아빠는 왜 언덕을 뛰어 내려가나요?
evs: There is a big mountain in the middle.
They climb up to see the view.
From the sea, they watch the orange lava.
why: 아빠가 «화산이다!» 라고 외쳐요. 화산은 위험해서 둘은 있는 힘껏 뛰어 내려가요.
Dad shouts that it is a volcano. They run down because it is dangerous.

qs.q: "Ari and Dad escaped the volcano just in time!" What does "just in time" mean?
evs: Ari and Dad sail to a small island.
They climb up to see the view.
From the sea, they watch the orange lava.
There is a big mountain in the middle.
why: 둘이 배를 타고 떠나자 바로 주황색 용암이 보여요. «just in time» 은 늦기 직전에 아슬아슬하게라는 뜻이에요.
Right after they sail away, they see the orange lava. "Just in time" means almost too late, but safe.

qs.q: How do Ari and Dad get away from the volcano?
opts: They hide in a cave on the mountain.
They run down the hill and sail away in the boat.
evs: They climb up to see the view.
They run down the hill as fast as they can.
Suddenly, the ground shakes. Rumble, rumble!
They jump into the boat and sail away.
why: 있는 힘껏 언덕을 뛰어 내려가서, 배에 뛰어올라 떠나요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
They run down the hill, and then they jump into the boat and sail away. You need both sentences.

ends: Ari and Dad find a new island with friendly turtles.
아리와 아빠가 다정한 거북이들이 사는 새 섬을 찾는다.
Ari draws a picture of the volcano for her class.
아리가 반 친구들에게 보여 주려고 화산 그림을 그린다.

write.src: “Let’s <u>get on the boat</u> before <u>the lava comes</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)

img.cover: From a small white sailboat on the blue sea, Ari, a girl with a short black bob, a yellow life jacket over a white T-shirt and red sneakers, and Dad, a tall man with a short beard, a blue cap and a green backpack, look back with wide eyes at a green island where a mountain sends up gray smoke and bright orange lava flows slowly down its side.

scenes.1: On a rocky mountain path with a view of the sea, Ari, a girl with a short black bob, a yellow life jacket over a white T-shirt and red sneakers, holds on to Dad, a tall man with a short beard, a blue cap and a green backpack, as small stones bounce on the shaking ground and thick gray smoke rises from the mountain top above them, and Dad points up and shouts.
scenes.2: Ari, a girl with a short black bob, a yellow life jacket over a white T-shirt and red sneakers, and Dad, a tall man with a short beard, a blue cap and a green backpack, run hand in hand down a grassy hill toward a small white sailboat waiting on the beach, with gray smoke filling the sky behind them.

alt.1: The ground shakes and smoke rises from the mountain.
alt.2: Ari and Dad run down the hill to their boat.
alt.cover: Ari and Dad sail away from the smoking volcano.
